description: Your lower limbs have shortened and splayed, slowing your bipedal movement.  As long as you're not wielding anything and you've got both wings, you're able to crawl quickly and quietly when you run or crouch.

msg_on.text: You hunch forward to crawl quickly on folded wings.

msg_off.text: You rise up to walk like a human.

//: Uses bespoke stuff here rather than the quadruped enchantments as bat-crawling gives different buffs.
